name: muzi-crayon-v2
label: Muzi 蜡笔手绘 V2
preamble: Restrained hand-drawn wax-crayon spot icons with uneven deep-navy outlines, simple organic shapes, flat mustard bodies, warm-white openings, tiny semantic rust-red accents only, and visible dry wax grain. Calm, mature and handmade rather than childish. No cast shadow, no tile, no badge, no gradient and no detached decorative ticks.

construction.grid: 24-unit keyline; live area about 72%; generous equal padding; optical sizing
construction.stroke: uneven deep-navy wax-crayon outline; thick rounded outer contour remains the visually heaviest element
construction.corner_radius: one soft organic radius language across all objects
construction.angles: flat front-facing geometry with only a slight organic tilt within 8 degrees
construction.detail_budget: one metaphor per icon; no more than four meaningful parts; matched abstraction across the set
construction.fill_rule: limited flat wax-crayon fills inside the navy outline; visible dry wax grain; no continuous shading or gradient
construction.color_rule: deep navy for outlines, mustard for the main body, warm white for openings, gray-brown for small support details; rust red only for an icon-specific semantic detail such as the contact seal
construction.shared_parts: reuse the same block proportions, paper corner, envelope flap and Muzi portrait silhouette whenever a related part recurs
construction.motif: no detached decorative mark; consistency comes from navy wax outlines, mustard fill and dry crayon grain

fits: Personal portfolio section markers and large spot illustrations at 48–96px.
notes: Revision requested by the user: remove every upper-right rust-red brush tick. About uses a simplified Muzi bust with dark shoulder-length hair and sunglasses resting on the head, not a generic mustard long-hair silhouette.
